values: NASA reports the Moon's orbital distance relative to the body it orbits, Earth.
Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System.
Mercury is the largest planet in the Solar System.
NASA identifies Jupiter as the largest planet in the Solar System.
Sodium chloride is commonly known as table salt.
Calcium carbonate is commonly known as table salt.
NIST identifies sodium chloride and lists salt as another name; its safety sheet also lists table salt.
NIST's atomic-number table lists oxygen as element 8.
Smithsonian describes bats as mammals and notes their mammalian characteristics.
Smithsonian explains that cephalopods, including octopuses, have three hearts.
NIDDK states that the liver makes bile.
Arteries generally carry blood away from the heart.
Arteries generally carry blood toward the heart.
NHLBI states that arteries take blood away from the heart.
MathWorld defines a regular hexagon as a regular polygon with six sides.
The government-supported NZ Maths resource explicitly gives square root of 64 as 8.
The Amazon River is in South America.
The Amazon River is in Europe.
The OAS describes the Amazon River Basin as lying in South America.
Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
Osaka is the capital of Japan.
The Government of Japan lists Tokyo as Japan's capital.
Jane Austen wrote Pride and Prejudice.
Charlotte Brontë wrote Pride and Prejudice.
The Morgan Library identifies Pride and Prejudice as Austen's novel and documents its 1813 edition.
The Odyssey is traditionally attributed to Homer.
The Odyssey is traditionally attributed to William Shakespeare.
Harvard's Center for Hellenic Studies discusses the traditional attribution of the Odyssey to Homer.
Mitochondria are involved in cellular ATP production.
Mitochondria are the primary site of photosynthesis.
NCBI's Molecular Biology of the Cell describes mitochondria as energy-converting organelles producing most cellular ATP.
Photosynthesis in plants occurs primarily in chloroplasts.
Photosynthesis in plants occurs primarily in ribosomes.
NCBI identifies chloroplasts as the organelles responsible for photosynthesis.
Light travels faster than sound in air.
Sound travels faster than light in air.
NASA directly compares light and sound and states that light travels much faster in air-scale examples.
Pure water freezes near 0 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
Pure water freezes near 50 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
NASA educational material states that water typically freezes at 0 degrees Celsius.
The first crewed Moon landing occurred in 1969.
The first crewed Moon landing occurred in 1979.
NASA documents Apollo 11 as the first crewed lunar landing mission in July 1969.
The U.S. National Archives timeline records Japan's 1945 surrender as ending World War II.
NIST documents binary multiples as powers of two, supporting binary notation's base-two structure.
HTTP is a protocol used for transferring web resources.
HTTP is an image file format.
IETF RFC 9110 defines HTTP as a protocol for interaction with and transfer of resource representations.
USGS lists basalt among common extrusive igneous rocks.
Earth's outer core is solid rock.
USGS states that Earth's outer core is entirely liquid.
The Pacific Ocean is Earth's largest ocean basin.
The Arctic Ocean is Earth's largest ocean basin.
NOAA identifies the Pacific as Earth's largest ocean basin and the Arctic as the smallest.
The equator crosses the continent of Africa.
The equator crosses the continent of Europe.
National Geographic states that Africa is divided almost equally by the Equator.
Instituto Cervantes describes Spanish as a Romance language inherited from Latin.
A trumpet is a brass instrument.
A trumpet is a string instrument.
The Library of Congress controlled vocabulary classifies trumpet under brass instruments.
NIDDK states that insulin lowers elevated blood glucose levels.
Plant roots commonly absorb water from soil.
Plant flowers are the primary organs that absorb water from soil.
USDA explains that land plants absorb soil water through roots and osmosis.

values: How to review the Pilot v3 factual freeze
Review each Source Review row. Open the URL and confirm the evidence supports the true claim and rules out the paired false claim.
Check the four Ambiguity Notes. Their qualifiers are deliberate protections, not unresolved errors.
Set researcher_decision to APPROVED or REVISE for all 30 source rows.
Set the four ambiguity decisions to APPROVED or REVISE.
Use researcher_comment for any requested replacement source or wording change.
Stop after review. Hidden splits and full dataset generation remain prohibited until factual-freeze approval.
